_note: Cluster combos: buildings that stand in the same cluster of plots (a run of plots between two lanes in one ring; see cluster in data/town.json) help each other, like neighbouring items in The Bazaar or Backpack Battles. Each combo names a building and the buildings it pairs with: every finished building of that type with at least one finished partner in its cluster gets effect. Effects: daily_food = extra food it brings in each dawn; craft_speed = its craftspeople work that much faster (0.5 = 50%). Buildings lean toward plots where they would complete a combo (combo_pull in data/town.json). sim/town.gd cluster_mates, World.combo_effect.
